certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Parsed from the Nevada Secretary of State 2024 Official Statewide General Election Results page. The archived official snapshot includes the President and Vice President of the United States table with county columns and reconciles to statewide candidate totals.

turnout.notes: Turnout is not loaded from the certified presidential results table because it does not include registered-voter denominators.

certifiedResults.title: Nevada official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential results are parsed from the Nevada Secretary of State 2024 Official Statewide General Election Results table. The live SOS page is protected from plain HTTP collection in this environment, so the build uses an archived official snapshot of the same page.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Wayback capture of Nevada Secretary of State official statewide general election results page; page heading says 2024 Official Statewide General Election Results, November 5, 2024.

wardDetail.title: Nevada precinct or reporting-unit detail
wardDetail.detail: The official statewide results table is county-level only. Review drilldowns need an official precinct, ward, or reporting-unit source before they can be enabled.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official SOS table checked during Nevada promotion; it provides county columns but not precinct rows.

turnout.title: Nevada turnout denominator
turnout.detail: The official presidential results table does not include registered-voter denominators. Turnout remains disabled until an official turnout or registration source is mapped.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Certified results table lacks registered-voter denominator fields.

sourceInventory.confidence: Nevada Secretary of State official statewide general election results table, collected through an archived official page snapshot because the live page is protected from plain HTTP access.

checkedNotUsable.reason: The live Nevada SOS page returned an Incapsula challenge to non-browser collection in this environment. The archived official SOS snapshot is used for the build instead.
checkedNotUsable.nextStep: Refresh from the live SOS page if browser-backed collection is added to the source pipeline.

turnoutPolicy.warning: Nevada turnout should not be inferred from the certified presidential results table because it lacks registered-voter denominators.
